limitations: Public website information; no on-site audit. Trail slopes, accessible parking and whether the restroom buildings are accessible are not described.

name: Licking River Greenway & Trails
address: Levassor Ave. & Eastern Ave. (behind Holmes High School), Covington, KY
limitations: Public website information; no on-site audit. Slopes, trail width, parking and restrooms are not described, and most of the route is unpaved or on streets.

facts.text: Covington's section includes 1.5 miles of nature trail, 0.75 mile of paved trail and about 2.5 miles that use sidewalks and roads. A parallel paved trail runs only part of the way.

history.note: Added from the linked official public source; no field observation or private visitor report is implied.

facts.text: Trail access points are behind Holmes High School at Levassor and Eastern avenues, at the dead end of East 16th Street, at Clayton-Meyer Park, and behind Randolph Park.

name: Campbell County Public Library — Newport Branch
limitations: Public website information; no on-site audit. The library's pages describe outreach services for the whole county, not the Newport building: entrances, parking, restrooms and routes are not described. Call the branch before your visit.

facts.text: Campbell County residents who can't visit the library because of a temporary or permanent illness or disability can get materials delivered at home, or by mail for free.

history.note: Added from the linked official public source; no field observation or private visitor report is implied.

facts.text: The library helps patrons sign up for the free Kentucky Talking Book service, for anyone unable to read because of a visual or physical limitation, and the national program of braille and audio materials sent by postage-free mail.

name: Boone County Public Library — Chapin Memorial Library
limitations: Public website information; no on-site audit. A small branch with limited staffed hours. The entrance, restroom and route inside are not described. Call ahead to discuss accommodations.

facts.text: Staff are present only part of the open hours (Tuesday and Wednesday 2–7 p.m., Thursday 1–7 p.m., and the first Saturday 9 a.m.–1 p.m.). To get in during unstaffed hours you need to complete an Express Access user agreement. Holds go to lockers on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

history.note: Added from the linked official public source; no field observation or private visitor report is implied.

facts.text: The library system says accessible parking is available at every location, and welcomes a phone call in advance to discuss other accommodations.
